originalTitle: Gorr: The God Butcher | Character Reveal Trailer | Marvel Rivals
content: The unholy crusader is ready to slay the gods. Gorr the God Butcher has arrived! 💀 The terrifying God Butcher has revealed his true form after defeating two deities back-to-back, and he's hungry for more. Once a deeply devout believer, the loss of his faith in the gods warped his will into a honed weapon with singular purpose. Gorr relentlessly executes his enemies while wielding the first symbiote, All-Black the Necrosword. His living sword absorbs the flesh of his enemies, and converting them into his army of Black Berserkers. While commanding his berserkers to crush his foes, he can travel across the battlefield to strike at the most unexpected angles until he unleashes the true power of the Annihilablade.
